runSummary.stalePolicy: Only offers verified within the last 48 hours are eligible for LIVE display.
runSummary.note: Full diversity sweep on 8.9.2026 20:52 CEST. No new unique promotion-grade item passed ranking and evidence gates. Fresh Profesia discovery found DHL Group IT Support in Bratislava at 2,000-2,200 EUR/month, but mandatory active English B2 plus broader IT/server support requirements are a material mismatch. LinkedIn public index returned Wolt Support Associate with English B2 and Sharp Brains onsite L1 with 1-3 years desktop-support requirements. Worki rediscovery was inactive. Kariera returned Grafton L1 complaints/support at 2,000 EUR, but requires technical university degree, similar experience and English B1. Upwork returned several Worldwide remote admin/e-commerce jobs, but low/ambiguous fixed budgets, country restrictions, competition or workload/skill burden kept them out of LIVE. Reddit yielded no fresh eligible hiring lead and Facebook public index yielded 0 verified hiring posts. Existing 50 LIVE items are preserved fail-closed.
